name: PV Inverter (string block)
description: A block of PV modules (one string group) with its three-phase string inverter - reference model SMA Sunny Tripower 10.0 (10 kW AC, up to 15 kWp, 2 MPP trackers, Modbus TCP). Power, yield, DC voltage, an on / off switch. One block - one point of control. Used by energy-field.

models.name: Sunny Tripower 10.0 (STP10.0-3AV-40)
models.purpose: Three-phase string inverter of one PV block - turns the modules' DC into the grid's AC.
